prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: unique wide 16:9 travel website hero for Ada Tours' seven-day Brazil MICE itinerary (São Paulo, Iguaçu, Amazon lodge, business conference in Rio). Create ONE coherent, highly photorealistic editorial photograph of a small international business delegation enjoying an excursion in Rio de Janeiro, seen from a scenic hill viewpoint with a geographically convincing broad view across Botafogo bay toward the unmistakable granite Sugarloaf Mountain. Four adults around 35–55, varied genders and skin tones, tasteful smart casual clothes suitable for warm weather, no ties, casually talking while looking toward the view. People are a modest secondary element in the right foreground; the magnificent Brazilian landscape, green hills, blue bay and layered city are dominant. Authentic candid gestures, no posed handshakes or promotional smiles, no devices held toward the camera. Warm late afternoon light with natural shadows, realistic skin and water texture, premium travel editorial photography, restrained saturated tropical colors. Wide horizontal landscape framing, plenty of uncluttered atmosphere and darker vegetation on the left third for existing website title overlay; primary subjects remain inside central crop-safe area. NOT a collage and no montage: do not combine Iguaçu, Amazon forest and São Paulo landmarks into Rio. No text, no logos, no watermark, no badges with letters, no readable signs, no generic conference-room stock scene. Render a polished full-width hero image, 16:9 composition.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: unique wide 16:9 travel website hero for Ada Tours' seven-day Panama MICE corporate programme featuring Panama Canal, Miraflores, Casco Viejo and Gamboa. Create ONE coherent photorealistic editorial travel photograph at a visitor observation terrace overlooking the historic Miraflores locks of the Panama Canal. The lock chambers, straight concrete walls, large container ship moving slowly through a lock and lush Panamanian tropical greenery are clearly visible and geographically believable. In the right foreground, a small corporate delegation of four adults around 35–55, varied genders and skin tones, dressed in tasteful lightweight business casual clothing, enjoys the engineering spectacle while an unobtrusive guide gestures toward the canal. People secondary and naturally candid, not posing for a stock-photo handshake. Main subject is the canal, ship, forest and experience of a corporate excursion. Bright soft morning light, natural tropical greens and deep blue water, fine realistic engineering detail, premium editorial travel photography. Broad horizontal 16:9 framing with a clear uncluttered left third for the existing website title; people placed within central crop-safe area. A single real-world style scene, no collage, no floating city skyline, no tropical beach, no imaginary landmarks, no invented hotel. No text, logos, readable badges, watermark or signs. Distinct from a sunset Rio cover, use a fresh clean morning atmosphere.
